title: sampling-rate-audit: paired audit of sampling-grid sensitivity in signal feature definitions
description:
Given a signal and a sampling rate, this package computes, for eighteen standard feature definitions, the paired relative deviation produced by a change of digital grid, with descriptive separation and effect-size summaries.

Within a declared numerical measurement model, the sampling rate is treated as an influence quantity: it is not the measurand, but changing it changes the computed feature while the source record is held fixed. The package isolates that component only. Analog front ends, anti-alias filtering, quantisation and clock jitter are not modelled, and they may reinforce or partially offset the grid component; the audit is therefore neither an upper nor a lower bound on the device-level discrepancy.

Contents: the leakage_audit engine (18 registered definitions), a command line, tests, examples, and invariance-agent, a guided interface that plans the structural signature of a definition from its formula, measures the paired deviation on a user record, and states the grid a tolerance needs - or that no grid will help. It deliberately refuses to print a universal minimum sampling rate.

Signature labels are heuristic structural warnings, not universal invariance orders or formal proofs. This record accompanies a manuscript under review. A second archive in the same record holds the per-record feature values, fit outputs and figures behind every table and figure of that manuscript; raw signals are not redistributed and every dataset is public.
